title: Ash Empire
concept: A fallen solar kingdom rebuilding after machine gods collapse the old economy.
premise: Ash Empire is a dark science fiction setting where a fallen solar kingdom rebuilding after machine gods collapse the old economy.
history: The world began as a response to a fallen solar kingdom rebuilding after machine gods collapse the old economy.
Its earlier age shaped the laws, factions, and technology around that pressure.
The present era reflects the consequences of that founding conflict.
factions: The Remnant Council of Ash Empire
powerSystem: Advanced systems, machine logic, and engineered infrastructure define capability.
conflict: Control of the system stack determines who can survive the next collapse.

The Guardian who protects fragile systems
The Challenger who exposes hidden costs
storyHooks: A new era begins in Ash Empire and the first decision defines the rest of the world.

A hidden faction wants the world to stay broken.
